items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: then Little Brother played these numbers for me over there

ctx.x: And then Little Brother played instrumental and sang songs and then Little Brother played these numbers for me over there, uh-huh. So the man give me $300.00 for that day's work and give Little Brother $300.00 too (inaudible).
Well, why did you play "I'm a Mighty Tight Woman" yourself? Didn't Little Brother know how to play that song?
